CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue coordinates) is listed alongside explicit representation/origin metadata for the same referent/time, showing identification, organization and a separate status/provenance entry.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified contents' presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names contents (red, blue) with their coordinate sets for specific referents/times.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are given separately from representation/origin metadata for the same referent/time, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: The report records how the content is represented (origin kind and represented_time) for the referent, indicating presentation/representation organization.
